name: email_draft_net_refundable_amount_calculation
use_case: Draft a reply on a customer's email thread for a person to review
branch: Draft a reply confirming the net refundable amount reflecting discounts rather than list price
tests: the agent reads Rachel Green's email thread th_r04_return_request_rachel, verifies order O18, and drafts a reply quoting the net amount $50.00 rather than $58.00 list price
instruction:
You emailed support earlier asking about returning the Slim-Fit Oxford Button-Down (SKU AP03) from order O18. You bought it on sale and want to make sure of the refund amount before returning. You are asking support in chat to draft a reply to your email thread stating the exact refund amount.

Your details:
- Name: Rachel Green
- Email: rachel.green@example.com
- Postal Code: 10014
- Order ID: O18
- Item: Slim-Fit Oxford Button-Down (SKU: AP03)

persona.name: Rachel G.
persona.initial_message: Hi! I sent an email about returning AP03 from order O18. Could you reply to my email thread confirming the exact refund amount I will receive?

arguments.subject: Re: Return request
arguments.body: Hello Rachel, the net refundable amount for AP03 from order O18 is $50.00 after applying the $8.00 line discount.

fixed.replyToMessageId: record: message rmsg_006 in thread th_r04_return_request_rachel
